lead: A `match` that splits one error site into a quiet arm and a throwing arm moves the throw below the gate's window.
body: `every_error_path_is_asserted_or_declared_unreachable` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/conformance_coverage.rs` reads only the 8 lines above a `Fault::` site, so a "no case can reach this" comment written above the whole `match` covers no arm once the arms push the throw down. Put the declaration on the throwing arm itself and name the `#[test]` that asserts that arm, since the one named above it covers the quiet arms.
